content: Taneni tepɨmaxiutani
Ne'iwama nemɨxenaki'erie, te'ɨkitamete xepɨka'akɨne yunaitɨ, hipatɨ xeikɨa, mɨpaɨ xetemaitɨ, tame temɨte'ɨkitamete tahetsie matsi waɨkawa pɨrahɨiwani.
Tanaitɨ waɨkawamekɨ tepekaxɨrɨwe. Xɨka xewitɨ niukitsie kahekawautseni, mɨkɨ tewi kanaye'aweni, yaxeikɨata kaniyɨwemɨkɨ yuwaiyaritsie naime mɨyupirenutɨanikɨ.
Kepauka kawayutsixi pirenu temɨwarutakeitsitɨwa memɨtatsi'anu'enienikɨ, mɨkɨkɨ wawaiyari naime tepukuhana.
Xekeneuxeiya kanuwa 'amɨpapa. Tsepa memu'eketɨka 'eka mɨtɨrɨkaɨyekɨ, ta'aurie mepaxɨriwa titunitsitɨwame 'etsimɨyewakɨ, kemɨtiyuwaɨriya ta'aurie mehɨanikɨ 'inɨ'awame.
Yaxeikɨata tawaiyaritsie taneni pɨyuxewi 'etsipetɨ, matsi mariweme mɨtiuyurieni kaniyɨweni. Xɨka makukɨyexiyatsie 'utinaini tai 'etsipemekɨ, mɨkɨ kaniyɨweni 'ahakuyeukame mutataiya.

Yaxeikɨata taneni tai hepaɨ kani'aneni, kwiepa timieme tikuxatatɨ 'apɨyeka tawaiyaritsie, tita mɨkatiheitserie naime tixatatɨ, tawaiyari naime kanitsewiximaka, pɨtatsixɨrimɨtsitɨa tatukari naime, xatsi taiyariyaritsie mieme panunetɨarie mɨtakakɨ.
Tewitɨtɨ yunaime katiniwamaxiutɨaweni, yeutari memayu'eririya, wikixi, kuuterixi, haramaratsie kiekatari, yunaitɨ mekanimaxiutsiewaweni,
matsi tewi pɨkayɨwe yuneni mɨmaxiutani. 'Axakaniutaineni xeikɨa 'uaye mɨmɨyakɨ kanihɨneni.
Tanenikɨ 'aixɨa teputiyuane Ti'aitame mɨta'ukiyari hepaɨtsita, meta tanenikɨ teɨteri tepɨwaruxaxata 'axamemɨ'itɨarienikɨ, tsepa Kakaɨyari hepaɨ me'anenetɨ memutiwewiya.
Xeitetayarita pɨwayeneika niuki 'aixɨa mɨ'itɨarienikɨ meta 'axamɨ'itɨarienikɨ. Ne'iwama nemɨxenaki'erie, mɨpaɨ pɨkareuyewetse.
¿Kamɨtsɨ kuta tiyɨwe haixa maneikani 'axeikɨa, haa 'akakatɨ meta hatsiwitɨ?

Ne'iwama nemɨxenaki'erie, ¿xapatsie ketiyɨwe huriwa takariyari mɨkaxuawere, meta kaxie nanayaritsie ketiyɨwe xapa takari mɨkaxuawere? Yaxeikɨata haixa ha'utsiwitɨ maneikatsie haa 'akakatɨ maneni pɨkayɨwe.
Yurikɨ kemɨtimaiwenikɨ taheima miemekɨ
Kemɨ'ane xeme mɨtimaiwe, xɨka waɨkawa timaika, 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ tiyurienetɨ keyuhekɨatani, tixaɨtɨ karayuyeitɨatɨ, kemɨreuyewetse mɨpaɨ mɨtiyurienenikɨ timaiwetɨ.
Mexɨka hatsiwimekɨ xeyu'uxiwe'erietɨ xeyɨaka meta yu'iyaritsie xehayuye'unietɨ, xeketeneuhayewa xete'itawatɨ meta xeheye'unietɨ tita yuri mɨraine.
Mɨkɨ mɨtimaiwenikɨ pɨkahɨkɨ taheima makaneika, kwiepa pɨta kanimiemetɨni tewi kemɨtimaiwe meta kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene wahetsie mayeneika.
Hakewa memeyu'uxiwe'erie meta mehayuye'unietɨ memexuawe, manata mekaniyuxamurieka meta 'axamɨti'anekɨ xeikɨa mepɨyɨa.

Matsi taheima miemekɨ mɨtimaiwenikɨ mɨ'ayumieme naimekɨ kani'itiyaka, meta 'aixɨa pɨtixeiyarie, pɨtiyukanaki'erie, pɨtiyu'aitɨarinɨa, yuheyemekɨ pɨtiyukanenimaya, 'aixɨa pɨtiyuriene, 'uximayatsika kemɨreuyewetse, huta 'iyariyari pɨkahexeiya, meta yakɨ xeikɨa pɨkayɨane.
Mɨkɨ teɨteri 'aixɨa memɨtewaxeiyatsitɨa, yu'uximayatsikakɨ kememɨte'u'etsa yu'iyaritsie kayuwatɨ mehexeiyatɨ, kemɨtitixuawere mɨkɨkɨ heitserie mekanipitɨariekuni.
